# Figure captions (generated by make_assets.py; do not edit by hand)

- `s3_success_ci.png` — S3 (Task 4) strict success per scenario (true stop distance ≤ 0.80 m, no fall; scenario 10 = correct not-found), dot = k/n, line = Wilson 95 % CI; n = 3 runs per scenario, 30 trials pooled (18/30); runs: 20261004-1716_rc_s3_r1, 20261004-1739_rc_s3_r2, 20261004-1754_rc_s3_r3 (given on the command line); source eval/e2e/results/<run>/results.jsonl.
- `s3_history.png` — S3 strict success per run (k/10 scenarios, one trial each) in chronological order, coloured by era (GT height (sim xpos) + v4/v5: 7 runs; no-GT height: 2 runs; final (fix/final, tag final): 5 runs; rc (final-r3 candidate): 3 runs); hatched = before the per-class stop margin; 17 runs plotted; run-to-era mapping and exclusions in s3_history.csv; source eval/e2e/results/<run>/results.jsonl.
- `parser_v5_v6.png` — LLM command-parser accuracy per category and model on the Standard set (45 commands) and the held-out Hard set (71), one run each, bar label = ok/n; prompt v5 vs v6 (v6 for gemini-3.8-flash, gpt-5-nano, qwen-flash only); source eval/results/{v5,hard/v5} and eval/results/{v6,hard/v6}/<model>.jsonl (eval/task3_eval.py).
- `turn_accuracy_latency.png` — Task 2 turns before vs after F3: (left) mean |settled heading error| per commanded angle, left/right pooled, closed-loop RealSkills.turn (n = 36, 12 per angle) vs executor 45° chunked turns (n = 18, 6 per angle); (right) stop latency when 'stop' arrives 0.8 s into a 180° turn, single turn vs chunked (n = 3 + 3); source docs/report_assets/task2/logs/turn_trials_*.jsonl, f3_exec_*.jsonl, f3_stop_latency.jsonl.
- `contacts.png` — S3 robot contact samples per scenario split into target object / other objects / terrain (mean per run; label = runs with any contact / runs), from eval.contact_classes of the S3 runs of figure 1: 3 runs (20261004-1716_rc_s3_r1, 20261004-1739_rc_s3_r2, 20261004-1754_rc_s3_r3), 30 scenario trials; source eval/e2e/results/<run>/results.jsonl.
- `parser_latency_cost.png` — LLM command-parser latency (p50 bar, p95 tick; LLM calls only, n = 43 per model/prompt) and cost per 100 commands (logged prompt/completion tokens × eval/task3_eval.py PRICES, USD per 1M tokens; precheck rejects cost 0) on the Standard set (45 commands, 1 run) for prompts v4 and v5; source eval/results/{v4,v5}/<model>.jsonl.
